answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 9610 Country: India Title: I want to ask that my brother he is a office going person and is 26 yrs in age. His hairs are turning white due to natural factor, please tell whther applying of black colour in hairs in order to make them black is permissible or not. Reply soon. Question: Assalamualikum, I want to ask that my brother he is a office going person and is 26 yrs in age. His hairs are turning white due to natural factor, please tell whther applying of black colour in hairs in order to make them black is permissible or not. Reply soon. Jazakumullahu Khaieran kaseeran Kaseera Answer ID: 9610 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2523/1952=H/1429) It is unlawful; we have been sternly prohibited in Hadith from doing so. In the abovementioned case also, it is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
